scope: Post hoc illustrations from existing experiments. No new model inference, fitting or statistical test.

original_normalization_case.selection: Article nearest the median interaction with paired sign-change positions; token nearest its median activation change.

gate_case.selection: Previously fixed median-gain article. Token nearest the median activity change among alphabetic negative-to-positive pieces selected on both passes.

opposite_activity_case.selection: Article nearest the median pass3-minus-pass1 raw reader effect among articles with an alphabetic positive-to-negative paired piece. Token nearest median activity change within eligible pieces.

example.context: considered quite prosperous and were host

mixed_activity_case.selection: Curated counterexample to a uniform token-level clock. Two readable positions in one paragraph with opposite activity-sign changes. No population claim is inferred from this curation.

examples.context: he made a number of summer sign

activity_profiles.status: Descriptive state observations on the completed fixed test, not additional independent tests.

representative_example.selection: Article nearest the median dot-only-minus-full MAE. Unit/pass with largest error reduction within that article.

limits: All identities were selected on development data. This tests the fixed eight units, not all native units.
The unit/pass cases are averaged within articles for primary forecasting inference.
Sign agreement is descriptive. The two forecasting intervals form a separate family from the eight new-unit phase intervals.
The measured endpoint is a local reader weight, not answer accuracy.

number_text_example.selection: Article nearest median numeric-target-minus-other loss contrast among42 eligible articles. Cue target nearest its median cue loss change.

number_name_case.selection: Curated numerical string inside a musician stage name, from the existing text example.
number_name_case.intervention: Expert105 removed at all routed positions on all three passes. The effect is not isolated to the displayed token.

math_example.selection: Question nearest the median three-order loss change for L12-E105.
